question: Which variables have the most missing data and in which years/countries?
summary: The most incomplete variable is "pm25_exposure" (84% missing), followed by "flaring_co2" (71%) and "gdp_change_10yr_pct" (68%). Gaps concentrate in the earliest decades, and 23 countries have no "pm25_exposure" values at all. Any analysis using these variables is effectively limited to later years and a subset of countries.
